categories.main_business_segments: The Group operates primarily in three segments: manufacturing and sale of laminates (including upstream materials such as glass fabric, glass yarn, specialty resins, and copper foil), property investment and rental, and investments (interest and dividend income). The laminates segment is the core business, contributing over 90% of revenue, while property and investments form smaller parts of the business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced manufacturing technologies for producing glass epoxy laminates, specialty resins, copper foil, and glass fiber materials. It emphasizes vertical integration and continuous technical improvements to enhance production efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and increase automation. The Group has established a state-of-the-art R&D center focusing on high-frequency, high-speed laminates for AI server applications and ultra-thin copper foils for IC packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream electronics manufacturers, particularly in automotive electronics, AI servers, cloud data centers, robotics, and smart wearables. The Group serves a broad client base including subsidiaries of Kingboard Holdings Limited and other PCB manufacturers. The electronics industry, especially AI and automotive sectors, are major end markets driving demand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's principal operations and manufacturing facilities are located in the People's Republic of China, with significant production capacity also in Thailand. It holds investment properties in Hong Kong, the UK, and China. Revenue is primarily derived from customers in the PRC, with additional sales in other Asian countries, Europe, and America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kingboard Laminates Holdings Limited operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing laminates and upstream materials such as copper foil and glass fiber products used by downstream PCB manufacturers and electronics assemblers. The Group is vertically integrated, controlling upstream raw materials and downstream laminate production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes R&D to develop high-end, high-value-added laminates tailored for AI, automotive electronics, and high-speed data applications. It invests in expanding copper foil capacity and low-dielectric glass fiber yarn production to meet market shortages. Sustainability initiatives include solar photovoltaic power and thermal energy recovery to reduce carbon emissions and energy costs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of laminates and related upstream materials. The property segment contributes rental income. The investments segment generates interest and dividend income from financial instruments. The Group also benefits from economies of scale and vertical integration to maintain competitive pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group faces intense competition in the laminates and electronic materials industry. It positions itself as a leading vertically integrated manufacturer with a broad client base, strong R&D capabilities, and cost-efficient production. Its focus on high-end products and sustainability differentiates it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of HK$18.54 billion, an 11% increase from 2023, and an underlying net profit attributable to owners of HK$1.35 billion, up 36%. The Group has shown steady growth with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 6% in revenue and 9% in net profit over the long term. It maintains a strong financial position with a net gearing ratio of 9%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group offers high-quality, reliable laminates and upstream materials with consistent on-time delivery, supported by vertical integration and economies of scale that enable competitive pricing and resilient gross margins. Its R&D focus on high-frequency, high-speed laminates for AI and automotive applications, along with sustainability initiatives, provide differentiated value to customers and enhance its market competitiveness.
